operator_io_quirks: DDL has missing commas between FOREIGN KEY clauses (CLASS, ENROLL) — sqlite_master stores the original text; CREATE TABLE replay must tolerate it (sqlite accepts it, but text is not re-parsable by naive splitters)
All columns notnull=0, no CHECK/UNIQUE constraints, no indexes/views/triggers — insert failures will be rare; PK uniqueness is the only real constraint
ENROLL and PROFESSOR have no PK (pk=[]); sample_fresh_primary_keys must no-op on empty PK, drop_unique_duplicates must no-op on no unique cols

FK graph has a cycle: DEPARTMENT.EMP_NUM -> EMPLOYEE, and CLASS.PROF_NUM -> EMPLOYEE, but DEPARTMENT<->EMPLOYEE is not a cycle; however COURSE->DEPARTMENT->EMPLOYEE and CLASS->COURSE, CLASS->EMPLOYEE give a DAG; no self-FK
EMP_HIREDATE/EMP_DOB/STU_DOB declared 'datetime' but stored as TEXT 'YYYY-M-D' (no zero padding, e.g. '1978-2-23') — Date fuzzer template must be %Y-%m-%d and leading-zero stripping applies
STU_TRANSFER declared 'numeric' but storage is integer 0/1 — Number fuzzer will emit floats; sqlite affinity NUMERIC will coerce, fine
STU_INIT has empty-string sample '' — String fuzzer length range [0,1] must allow empty
STU_PHONE varchar(4) holds 4-digit strings; DEPT_EXTENSION/PROF_EXTENSION varchar(4) hold 4-digit strings — String fuzzer will produce random alnum, breaking phone/extension semantics

CLASS_TIME varchar(20) holds 'MWF 8:00-8:50 a.m.' — declared type does NOT contain 'time' as a word boundary issue? it does contain 'time' substring; ts_fuzzer says String, so dispatch is on lowercased type 'varchar(20)' not column name — confirm
STU_NUM values are 6-digit (321452) while EMP_NUM are 3-digit (100) — Number fuzzer range [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from 'int' args (none) => default scale; PKs will be small ints, not 6-digit
CLASS_CODE varchar(5) PK holds '10012'..'10021' (5-digit strings) — String fuzzer will emit random 0-5 char strings, PK collisions likely, sample_fresh_primary_keys will drop many rows
All tables tiny (6-37 rows); choose_table_sizes level-0 = 1+30u, next x4 capped 2500 — instances will be much larger than originals, FK fan-out from small parents
operator_ts_expectations: Date fuzzer on EMP_HIREDATE/EMP_DOB/STU_DOB: template %Y-%m-%d (first parsable element '1978-2-23'), range from min/max parsed dates, leading-zero strip since no element starts with 0 and none contains '-0'
Number fuzzer on EMP_NUM/STU_NUM/PROF_NUM/STU_HRS/STU_TRANSFER: int scale default, range [-10^s,10^s]; STU_TRANSFER numeric -> float draws, sqlite coerces to int 0/1 only if value is integral

Number fuzzer on CRS_CREDIT float(8) and STU_GPA float(8): scale=8, precision=8 => range [-1e8,1e8], wildly implausible credits/GPA (FN driver: queries filtering GPA between 2 and 4 or credits=3 will find few/no rows)

String fuzzer on all varchar columns: CHARSET a-zA-Z 0-9() with length in [min,max+1] of elements; e.g. CLASS_CODE length [5,6], EMP_INITIAL [1,2], STU_INIT [0,2] — random strings, not 'ACCT-211' style (FN driver: LIKE 'ACCT%' or ='CIS-220' misses)
String fuzzer on EMP_JOBCODE/STU_CLASS/PROF_HIGH_DEGREE/ENROLL_GRADE: random strings, not the 4-value enums (FN driver: IN ('CUST','TECH') or grade='A' misses)

FK columns (CLASS.CRS_CODE, CLASS.PROF_NUM, COURSE.DEPT_CODE, DEPARTMENT.EMP_NUM, ENROLL.CLASS_CODE, ENROLL.STU_NUM, PROFESSOR.EMP_NUM, PROFESSOR.DEPT_CODE, STUDENT.DEPT_CODE) draw from parent's FINAL filtered values with replacement — ties/duplicates in child FK columns are common (FP driver: joins produce duplicate rows, COUNT differs from gold)

PK columns (CLASS_CODE, CRS_CODE, DEPT_CODE, EMP_NUM, STU_NUM) get max_l0=inf (single-col PK) so fresh draws never reuse — but String PKs still collide by chance, sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicates, shrinking tables
ENROLL/PROFESSOR have no PK: no dedup, rows can be fully duplicated (FP driver: SELECT DISTINCT vs not, COUNT(*) inflated)
DEPARTMENT.EMP_NUM is FK to EMPLOYEE but also semantically 'department chair' — TS treats it as plain FK, so chair may be any employee (plausible; not a miss driver)
STU_PHONE/DEPT_EXTENSION/PROF_EXTENSION varchar(4) get random alnum strings, not digits (FN driver: phone LIKE '2%' or extension='3119' misses)
CLASS_TIME varchar(20) gets random strings, not 'MWF 8:00-8:50 a.m.' (FN driver: time-of-day filters miss)

p=0.2 default, whole-instance p=0 w.p. 0.3: 30% of instances use only literal-pool/original values (no fresh draws) — those instances are more plausible but have fewer distinct values (FP driver: ties)
